bookingCta.title: Book your chair.
bookingCta.description: Choose a time. We handle the rest: calm, precision, and a cut that speaks for itself.

items.a: Five minutes is ideal. Walk-ins are welcome when a chair is free, but appointments always take priority.

items.q: Which service is right for me?
items.a: Start with the Signature Cut for most short to medium styles. Prefer a sharper fade? Book the Precision Fade. Want the full reset? Choose the ZENIZZ Ritual.

items.q: Do you work on all hair types?
items.a: Yes: straight, wavy, curly, coarse, fine, and textured. We specialize in short and medium lengths.
Please cancel at least 5 hours ahead. Arrivals more than 10 minutes late may need to reschedule.

about.title: About
about.metaDescription: Discover the story behind ZENIZZ, a premium barbershop in Istanbul built around craft, presence, and precision.
about.heroTitle: An atelier for those who take the craft seriously.
about.heroDescription: ZENIZZ started with a simple question: what if a barbershop felt like the quiet between work and home? Warm, editorial, and masterfully executed.
about.paragraph1: We specialize in short to medium lengths: fades, scissor work, beard sculpting, and classic rituals. Not because it's trendy, but because that's where our craft is sharpest.
about.paragraph2: The interior, the light, the tools, the pace: everything is chosen to create presence. At ZENIZZ, you're not just handled. You're seen.
about.aboutAlt: Yusuf at work in the ZENIZZ atelier

signature-cut.name: Signature Cut
signature-cut.description: A tailored haircut with fade or scissor work, finished with a hot towel and neck shave.

precision-fade.name: Precision Fade
precision-fade.description: Sharp fades with close attention to texture, shape, and balance, from skin fade to soft taper.

scissor-cut.name: Scissor Cut
scissor-cut.description: Full scissor work for medium lengths. Soft layers, movement, and a natural flow.

beard-sculpt.name: Beard Sculpt
beard-sculpt.description: Beard shaping with trimmer and razor, including a hot towel and nourishing aftercare.

hot-towel-shave.name: Hot Towel Shave
hot-towel-shave.description: A classic straight razor shave with warm towels, rich lather, and a cold towel finish.

cut-beard.name: Cut and Beard
cut-beard.description: Our signature haircut paired with beard sculpting: the complete grooming ritual.

zenizz-ritual.name: ZENIZZ Ritual
zenizz-ritual.description: Our signature journey: consult, cut, beard or shave, scalp massage, and a styled finish.

junior-cut.name: Junior Cut
junior-cut.description: For boys up to 12. Patient, precise, and at an easy pace.

yusuf.bio: Yusuf built ZENIZZ on the belief that a haircut is more than technique. It's presence, calm, and craftsmanship.

r1.text: I'm visiting from the Netherlands, and this is what I'd call a proper European barber!

r2.text: Zenizz's team are the real deal. Highly recommended!

r3.text: A top barber. Full satisfaction, a real recommendation. They genuinely listen to what the client wants, and there was an excellent consultation before the cut.

r4.text: I'm so glad I found this place. It's a fantastic barbershop, and I plan on getting my hair cut here for years to come.

r5.text: Very friendly service and a perfect haircut. The barber works cleanly, takes his time, and pays attention to every detail. A real recommendation, the best in Istanbul!

r6.text: Very helpful, and a great haircut.
